items.title: How many floods will it take for Nepal to act?
items.summary: Disaster risk reduction is rarely a priority until a disaster strikes close to home. Yet even the destruction caused by the Bhote Koshi flood on July 8, 2025, was not enough to spur the state into taking meaningful action to reduce future risks. items.title: Bhotekoshi floods leave 269 children without one or both parents
items.summary: A study of 584 children living in holding centres in Kathmandu, Nuwakot and Rasuwa finds that 41 had lost both parents, 161 their fathers and 67 their mothers.
